info.title: SysDVR
info.author: exelix11
info.description: Stream gameplay over USB or network.
info.details:
SysDVR is a sysmodule for streaming gameplay capture over USB or a local network.

The full package supports both network and USB streaming and includes the SysDVR Settings homebrew application for changing streaming modes and configuration.

SysDVR runs in the background as a sysmodule and can be started or stopped when needed to reduce sysmodule memory usage.

changelog:
v6.3

Changes:
- Fix a service initialization issue that when combined with ldn_mitm would cause the system settings to crash. Now SysDVR should work alongside ldn_mitm without issues. #295
- Support AAC codec for video recording. Recorded clips can now be played on Windows without needing additional conversion steps.
- Reintroduce support for the `--file` command line option to record clips from the command line
- Remember the last used IP address when starting a manual network connection #364
